decision.recommendation: Request clarification from the requester before any approval routing. This request is for SignalWatch Advanced ($24,000/year, 25 users) for production observability in Engineering. However, Engineering already has an approved SignalWatch license (80 seats, $80,000/year) that covers production monitoring. The request lacks a clear business purpose explaining why a new license is needed. Additionally, the vendor security assessment expired on 2025-07-01 (456 days old), and there is a conflict between the vendor registry and vendor-risk service. The request requires clarification on business purpose, vendor security status, and data access level before any approval routing.
